svg.title: Gestion des projets — C4 container view
svg.desc: C4 container diagram: the project manager uses the Angular frontend; nginx serves it and proxies /api/ to the Spring Boot backend, which reads and writes MySQL. In the monitoring profile Prometheus scrapes the backend's actuator metrics, Grafana queries Prometheus and Prometheus fires alerts to Alertmanager. SonarQube, backed by PostgreSQL, is the quality gate: Jenkins sends both analyses and polls both gates. Jenkins deploys the stack and pushes the images to Docker Hub; the developer pushes code and reads Grafana and SonarQube.
